skill.name: White Knight's Shield
skill.description:
Grant ally SGs, SMGs, HGs, and Fairies a shield with a base HP of #1 points for #2 seconds. The shield gains additional HP based upon the target's missing HP, with the minimum increase being 0.8x and the maximum being 1.8x. 
When Stella is present, Sei's attacks count toward Stella's passive skill.
Favorite Drink: When buffed by a Moonblast, skill takes effect for the duration of the Moonblast, and the additional shield HP gain based upon the target's missing HP is doubled.

skill.name: Secret Modifications
skill.description:
Press to toggle between Nano-Camo and MIRD-113.
MIRD-113: When activated, increase self damage by #1 and decrease the accuracy of all allies in the same column by #2 but increase their evasion by #3 (cannot activate Python's passive).
Nano-Camo: When activated, increase self evasion by #4 and decrease the evasion of all allies in same column by #5 but increase their accuracy by #6 (cannot activate Python's passive).
When Dorothy is in the center row, she activates Nano-Camo by default and MIRD-113 otherwise.
Favorite Drink: When buffed by a Piano Woman, reduce the debuff effect of her skill by 50%.

skill.name: Puppet Mask
skill.description:
Active: Increase damage by #1 for #2 seconds.
Passive: After her puppets attack #3 times, her next attack gains an extra 50% critical damage.
When Sei is present, Stella grants Sei 10% skill cooldown reduction (does not affect initial cooldown time).
Favorite Drink: When buffed by a Bleeding Jane, the passive effect only requires #4 attacks to trigger.

skill.name: Love and Dreams
skill.description:
Summon two drones that each deal #1 damage per hit for #2 seconds.
Favorite Drink: when buffed by a Brandtini, drones last 1 second longer.

skill.name: Crimson Geyser
skill.description:
Jump up and pound the ground to create a big explosion, dealing #1 damage to enemies within a radius of 2 and knocking them back. Every point of armor increases the damage by 1%.
Favorite Drink: When buffed by a Big Beer, gain 0.5 point of shield HP per point of armor.
Normal attack: Launch an exploding rocket punch that deals #2 damage to a single target with a #3 knockback chance (does not stack with slug ammo).

skill.name: Full Moon Protector
skill.description: Passive: Gain a 10-HP shield at the start of battle, lasting for 8s. When shielded, obtain a stack of "Damage Mark" every 2s, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Each "Damage mark" stack increases her damage by #1 for #2s. When not shielded, obtain a stack of "Evasion Mark" every 2s, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Each "Evasion Mark" stack increases her evasion by #3 for #4s. Active: Gain a 10-HP shield for 8s. For every stack of "Damage Mark", increase rate of fire by #5; for every stack of "Evasion Mark", gain an additional #6-HP shield. Effects last for #7s.

skill.name: Tower of Tisiphone
skill.description: Passive: Obtain a Tarot Card every 3 attacks, up to a maximum of 3 Tarot Cards. Each Tarot Card increases her damage by #1 for #2s. Active: Consume all Tarot Cards and fire a shot that will not miss, dealing #3 damage to the furthest target and possible critical damage. Additionally, deal additional damage to enemies within a 1-unit radius around the target. The additional damage is equal to #4 the number of Tarot Cards consumed, up to a maximum of #5 damage.

skill.name: Puppet Trick
skill.description: Passive: When there is an enemy unit within a 2-unit distance, switch to using a bayonet to deal 2x damage to the nearest target. In this state, no ammo is consumed and rate of fire increases by #1 (this passive will not take effect when using Slug ammo). If there are no enemy units within a 2-unit distance, increase maximum hit targets by 1. Active: Increase damage by #2 and movement speed by #3 for #4s.

skill.name: Thinker's Key
skill.description: Passive: While in Charging Mode, this unit cannot perform normal attacks. For every 2s after a battle has begun, obtain a Charge up to a maximum of 5 Charges. Each Charge increases her damage by #1. Active: Enter Attack Mode. After Attack Mode expires, reload and remove all damage buff from Charging mode, then re-enter Charging Mode. When equipped with "Spectacles", Charging Mode grants 8-HP shields to all allied units in front of her for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. When equipped with "Meteorite", Charging Mode increases all allies' damage by 5% for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. When equipped with "Wristwatch", Charging Mode grants her 1 extra ammo.

skill.name: Extreme Shooting
skill.description: Passive: Increase damage by 12% at the start of battle. This buff gradually decays by 4% every 2s, and is completely removed after 6s. The buff will refresh itself every 10s. Active: Sacrifice #1 of accuracy to increase rate of fire to a fixed 150 for #2s.

skill.name: Mobile Cover
skill.description: Deploy a mobile cover ahead of self lasting for #1 seconds. The cover will have #2 of the user's maximum HP and gain taunt effect after deployment.

skill.name: Sticky Bombs
skill.description: Every #1 seconds, automatically place a sticky bomb on the enemy with the highest HP. When skill is activated, detonate all sticky bombs on the field, each dealing #2 guaranteed damage that scales with Dummy-Links within an area of 1.5 units. A maximum of 3 sticky bombs can be placed on each unit.

skill.name: Jashin-chan Dropkick
skill.description:
Active: Jashin-chan Dropkick! Jashin-chan executes a powerful dropkick against the enemy unit with the highest HP, gaining 1.5s of invincibility while dealing #1 damage to enemies in the epicenter (within a 1.5-unit radius). The dropkick also deals damage to enemies on the outer ring (within a 4-unit radius), ranging from a minimum of #2 to a maximum of #3 damage. The more enemies there are in the epicenter, the higher the damage.
 Passive: Jashin-chan uses her dropkick as normal attacks and deals AoE damage to the nearest enemy unit in a 1-unit radius. These attacks are affected by the target's evasion and armor and scale with Dummy-Links. Jashin-chan generates a shield whose value equals 10% of her lost HP every 10s.

skill.name: Angelic Contract
skill.description:
Passive: Pekola cannot attack in her initial state. She can only attack once she has gained 5 stacks of buff and recovered her halo.
 Deal 1x damage that ignores armor and shield to the enemy unit with the lowest health percentage, as well as additional damage that equals #1 of the target's lost HP (not exceeding 100% of Pekola's damage stat). Her attacks also have a #2 chance of removing all buffs on the target.
 Active: Grant all allies shields whose value equals 5% of their own maximum HP, lasting 5 seconds.

skill.name: Gorgon's Eye
skill.description: Attack random enemies, giving them a stack of debuff that reduces their evasion and accuracy by #1 to a maximum of 5 stacks, lasting #2 seconds. When her skill is activated, petrify (daze) enemy units with debuffs and give them an additional #3 of vulnerability. Each stack of debuff increases the petrification duration by 1 seconds. Each unit can only be petrified 1 times.

skill.name: Eternal Penance
skill.description:
Active: Cast a spell on the enemy unit with the highest HP, dealing #1 damage to enemies within a 2.5-unit radius and binding them for #2 seconds.
 Passive: After each reload, randomly obtain 1 torture device as a buff.
 Trident: Instantaneously increase all allies' ammo by #3 and increase their damage by #4 for 8 seconds.
 Iron Maiden: Yurine's attacks reduce targets' rate of fire and move speed by #5 for #6 seconds. When an enemy gains 5 stacks of debuff, her attacks daze them for #7 seconds and deal #8 damage.
 Chainsaw: Each attack deals an additional #9 guaranteed damage that ignores armor and shield.

skill.name: Demonic Punch
skill.description: Charge forward and daze enemies for #1 seconds, dealing #2 damage that does not scale with Dummy-Links and an additional instance of damage that equals #3 of her targets' maximum HP (not exceeding 50x of Minos' damage stat). After each reload, Minos regenerates shield points that equal #4 of her maximum HP. Shield regeneration does not stack.

skill.name: Romero's Cheering Woof!
skill.description:
Passive: At the start of the battle, the zombie dog enters the battlefield with #1 of the present Franchouchou members' combined damage, 30% of their combined rate of fire, and #2 of their combined accuracy.
This unit cannot be targeted by enemies, cannot make critical hits, and does not benefit from any buff tile effects. When Tae Yamada retreats from the battlefield, the zombie dog will also retreat.
Active: Throw his own head at the enemies, dealing #3 damage to all enemy units within a 1.5-grid radius and reducing their evasion by #4, lasting #5 seconds.

When she is the echelon leader, and her four teammates are all Franchouchou members, other Franchouchou members who are not in the echelon will enter the battlefield with 30% of all her stats at the start of the battle to provide support.
If all Franchouchou members are present at the start of the battle, generate a shield in front of the echelon. The shield's HP, evasion, and armor equal 15% of all Franchouchou members' combined HP, 50% of their combined evasion, and 30% of their combined armor.
While the shield exists, Franchouchou members take 80% less damage, but once it disappears, they all take 50 points of damage.

Active: Summon the "legendary oiran" and execute a slash attack that deals #2 damage to all enemy units in a cross-shaped area.

skill.name: Neural Fissure
skill.description:
Passive: After losing a Dummy-Link, clear all current debuffs, increase evasion by #1, and gain a shield with #2 of her max. HP, lasting 5 seconds.
Active: Hack all enemy units on the battlefield, reducing their evasion and armor by #3 for 5 seconds. With every kill that she contributes to while the skill is active, grant all echelon members 1 stack of buff that increases their attack and accuracy by 5%. Grant 3 stacks of buff if an elite enemy is killed. This buff lasts 5 seconds and can stack up to 5 times.

skill.name: Art of Explosion
skill.description:
Passive: After contributing to a kill, the next attack is upgraded to an explosive grenade, which prioritizes the enemy unit with the highest HP, dealing #1 damage and #2 damage that scales with Dummy-Links in a radius of 2.5.
Active: Increase damage by #3 for 5 seconds. Each kill she contributes to while the skill is active prolongs the skill duration by 2 seconds.

skill.name: Nightmare and Death
skill.description:
Active: Tap to switch between attack modes. Attack with machine gun/RPG after the next reload.
RPG: Deal #1 guaranteed damage to the nearest enemy unit and an additional #2 damage that scales with Dummy-Links in a radius of 2.5. Reload after each attack.
Machine Gun: Deal 100% damage to the nearest enemy unit. Deal an additional #3 damage to targets with no Dummy-Links.

skill.name: Physical Passivation
skill.description:
Passive: Each attack has a 10% chance of reducing the target's armor and evasion by #1 for #2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
Active: Upon activation, the next 3 attacks will deal #3 damage to the enemy with the highest HP and will always trigger the passive armor and evasion debuffs. If the target has a stat buff, dispel one type of stat buff and increase the damage of all echelon members by 10% for 5 seconds.
(When equipped with Medkit, upon skill activation, grant all allies who have lost Dummy-Links a shield with 10% of Evita's maximum HP for 10 seconds.)

skill.name: Seething Murderous Intent
skill.description:
Passive: For every enemy killed in this battle, gain 1 stack of Amplification (damage, accuracy, and evasion increased by 10%) throughout the battle, stacking up to 5 times.
Active: Grant all echelon members 1 stack of Amplification for #1 seconds. Immediately trigger a special self buff upon reaching enough Amplification stacks.
Upon reaching 2 stacks, increase damage and accuracy by 50% for 5 seconds.
Upon reaching 3 stacks, gain a shield with 5% of maximum HP and 5% damage intake reduction for 50 seconds.
Upon reaching 4 stacks, attacks are guaranteed to crit and ignore shields for 5 seconds.
Upon reaching 5 stacks, in the next 5, negate an instance of damage that would otherwise kill a Dummy-Link.
(When equipped with Alloy Carabiner, gain a permanent Amplification stack at the beginning of subsequent battles for each victory in a stage, stacking up to 3 times.)
